content:
lina: Noticed a bunch of tickets where customers complained about unpredictable bill jumps after embedding uploads. They sent mixed dim batches and saw unit spikes.

tor: I think the main problem is lack of transparent pre-request estimate. users can't see how the splitter will charge them.

frank: Proposal: add response header `X-Embed-Estimate: units=42;split=true` on preflight and when we accept requests. Console should show an "Estimate" column in routes so RM can preview unit impact.

sre-oncall: Telemetry: emit `embeds.estimate_sent` counter and `embeds.unit_delta_pct` per-tenant. Alert if any tenant delta > 15% sustained 10m.

lina: UX: add a per-tenant canary toggle in console that forces preflight on real traffic for that tenant only, and overlays estimate vs actual units for 24h. Helps customers opt-in before enabling client-side split.

console-bot: feature-flag rollout planned: `embeds.estimate-header` -> canary tenants -> collect 24h -> surface in console. Will post canary health here. :gear:

frank: router change: if header present, include `estimate_id` in traces so we can reconcile preflight -> actual. Also log `router_reason=estimate_override|splitter`.

sre-oncall: I'll add the alert dashboards and a small report that lists tenants where estimate under/overshot by >10%.

lina: Action items: frank - header + trace id, tor - console canary toggle + UI, sre-oncall - metrics+alerts. Recheck after first 24h canary report. :thumbsup:
